commitMessage:
Bug 532706 - Update minings when code mining manager is initialized

After fCodeMiningManager is initialized in
ensureCodeMiningManagerInstalled, it is not assured that
updateCodeMinings() is called afterwards. The initial reconciling has
already called before an annotation painter is set. But only when this
has happened the code mining is properly installed and an initial mining
has to be shown. Thus ensureCodeMiningManagerInstalled calls
updateCodeMinings after initialization of the manager.

Also changed guard conditions since it is intended to check that the
code mining manager is set, but method hasCodeMiningProviders is from
its name not so clear that this is implied by calling it.

Change-Id: Ic79743178aa3302d38586770246ca7d749401e15
Signed-off-by: Karsten Thoms <karsten.thoms@itemis.de>
summary: Inline SourceViewer.hasCodeMiningProviders() with direct field access for improved clarity and micro-performance.

Change-Id: I3dec0e683305ab3382605168c0505d5ce2bcc35e
Signed-off-by: Mickael Istria <mistria@redhat.com>

Fix some bad int/double conversions

Reported by SonarQube

Change-Id: I612ffc9b459e8cdf9c0d043dfaa1633cdefc6c1d
Signed-off-by: Mickael Istria <mistria@redhat.com>
dslRule:
<!id: fix.integer.division.before.ceil>
<!description: Add explicit double cast to the numerator before integer division passed to Math.ceil to ensure floating-point division. This prevents loss of precision due to integer division.
Applies when the expression is cast to int and then passed to Math.ceil.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: precision, arithmetic, bug-fix>

(int) java.lang.Math.ceil($numerator / $denominator)
=> (int) java.lang.Math.ceil((double) $numerator / $denominator)
;;
summary: Adds an explicit double cast to the numerator of a division expression passed to Math.ceil, ensuring floating-point division instead of integer division when the result is cast to an int.

Bug 534276 - [code mining] Draw of line which have line header

dslRule:
<!id: styledtext.drawbackground.to.gc.fillrectangle>
<!description: Replace StyledText.drawBackground with GC.fillRectangle for direct drawing, particularly when GC background is already set. This addresses rendering issues and clarifies intent.
Ensure the StyledText and GC instances are correctly identified by their types.>
<!severity: INFO>
<!tags: swt, drawing, api-modernization>

$styledText.drawBackground($gc, $x, $y, $width, $height) :: instanceof($styledText, "org.eclipse.swt.custom.StyledText") && instanceof($gc, "org.eclipse.swt.graphics.GC")
=> $gc.fillRectangle($x, $y, $width, $height)
;;
summary: Replaces calls to `StyledText.drawBackground()` with `GC.fillRectangle()` when the target is `StyledText` and `GC` for direct background filling, as `GC.setBackground()` is typically called before.
